title: Senior Growth Manager (Contract)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 Working as a Senior Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.
 This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.
 This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.
 The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing, and Community teams while maintaining the autonomy and entrepreneurial mindset required to scale successful initiatives to other markets.
 Responsibilities:
 User & Community Growth Strategies: Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture communities.
 Growth Experimentation: Design and execute growth experiments aimed at addressing gaps in content supply, community density, contribution, discovery, engagement, and user growth. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by testing ideas quickly, learning from results, and iterating accordingly.

description:

For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 We are searching for a strategic community management and operations expert to join the International Community team and help grow Reddit outside of the US. As an integral part of the International Growth team, this role plays a key role in helping Reddit realize its mission: bringing community and belonging to everyone in the world.
 This contract engagement is open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland.
As the Community Manager, you will be at the forefront of jumpstarting and fostering local communities. You will be an expert of the French market, proficient in English and French, and focused on proactive initiatives to build bridges with local volunteer moderators and innovate, iterate, refine, and scale our international consumer playbook. The insights derived from your relationships and experiments will help accelerate our growth in the market.
 Required Qualifications:
 Gain a deep understanding of the market to identify user and local moderator challenges, and market opportunities.
 Iterate, innovate, and scale the consumer growth playbook by recognizing new opportunities, suggesting bold ideas and programs, and persuading internal teams to align on new plans.
 Build strategic plans to cultivate, recruit, educate, and grow a local community of moderators (i.e., volunteers who develop, maintain, and shape the culture of local communities). Implement a conversion funnel designed to onboard power users and external creators, transforming them into active moderators.

title: Lead Client Partner, UK Enterprise Sales - Financial Services
description:

 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

You will harness the power of AI-driven solutions and data intelligence to optimise client outcomes and elevate the client experience. Our advertising business is thriving, our user base continues to grow, and we believe the impact of this role can fuel our company to grow in unprecedented ways.

title: Commercial & Mid-Market Sales Engineer
description:
Datadog Sales Engineer 는 고객 및 파트너와의 기회를 검증하고 성사시키는 데 도움을 줍니다. 영업 프레젠테이션, 제품 데모, 기술 평가(POC) 지원을 통해 기술 전문 지식을 제공합니다. Sale Engineer 는 제품 팀과 함께 고객, 경쟁사, 파트너의 의견을 바탕으로 기능의 우선순위를 정하는 데 도움을 줍니다. 또한 다양한 팀과 협력하여 고객의 문제를 해결하고, 버그 문제를 에스컬레이션하며, 브랜드 홍보대사로서의 역할도 수행하게 됩니다. 무한한 잠재력을 지닌 친절하고 열정적인 팀에 합류하고 싶은 분들의 많은 지원 바랍니다!
 Datadog은 사무실 문화를 통해 구축되는 관계와 협업, 창의성을 중시합니다. 우리는 데이터독 직원들이 자신에게 가장 적합한 일과 삶의 조화를 이룰 수 있도록 하이브리드 업무 환경을 운영하고 있습니다.
 담당 업무
 영업팀과 협력하여 고객에게 전반적인 Datadog 가치 제안, 비전 및 전략을 명확하게 전달
 경쟁력 있는 지식, 기술력 및 신뢰를 구축하기 위해 지속적으로 새로운 기술을 학습
 잠재 고객을 대상으로 제품 및 기술 프레젠테이션 제공
 제품 팀과 직접 소통하여 기능 요청에 대해 협업
 고객의 제품 온보딩을 돕고 장애물이 있을 때 지원
 사전 판매 수명 주기 동안 다양한 기술적 과제에 대해 창의적으로 생각
 자격 요건
 DevOps 모니터링 또는 아키텍처 도구에 대한 지식과 경험이 풍부
 외부 고객 또는 내부 팀에게 기술 프레젠테이션/데모를 편안하고 자신감 있게 전달 가능한 분
 다양한 과제에 대해 창의적으로 사고할 수 있으며, 매일 새로운 것을 발견할 수 있는 분
 Windows 또는 Linux 시스템 관리 경험
 클라이언트 사이트를 오가며 최대 4시간 동안 앉아있을 수 있는 분
 자동차, 기차 또는 항공으로 최대 25%까지 이동 가능한 분
 Datadog은 모든 계층의 사람들을 소중히 여깁니다. 모든 사람이 입사 첫날에 위의 모든 자격 요건을 충족하지 못할 수도 있습니다. 괜찮습니다. 기술에 대한 열정이 있고 자신의 역량을 키우고 싶다면 지원하실 것을 권장합니다.
 혜택 및 성장 :
 최우수한 수준의 온보딩
 풍성한 글로벌 혜택
 사내 네트워킹을 위한 부서 내 멘토 및 버디 프로그램
 신규 채용 우리사주(RSU) 및 직원 주식 매입 계획(ESPP)
 지속적인 전문성 개발, 제품 교육 및 커리어 경로 제공
 포용적인 기업 문화, 커뮤니티 길드 및 포용성 토크에 참여할 수 있습니다.
 위에 나열된 혜택 및 성장은 근무 국가 및 데이터독 고용의 성격에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다.

title: Commercial & Mid-Market Sales Engineer
description:
As a Commercial & Mid-Market Sales Engineer, you will provide technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, and supporting technical evaluations (POVs). Sales Engineers help qualify and close opportunities with customers and partners and have a voice with the product team to help prioritize features based on input from customers, competitors, and partners.
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.
 What You’ll Do:
 Partner with the Sales team to articulate the overall Datadog value proposition, vision and strategy to customers
 Own technical engagement with customers during the trial phase. Communicate Datadog’s value based on activities and work with customers on any identified issues or concerns to successful conclusion
 Technically close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill, and credibility
 Deliver product and technical briefings / presentations to potential clients
 Maintain accurate notes and feedback in CRM regarding customer input both wins and losses
 Proactively engage and communicate with customers and Datadog business/technical teams regarding product feedback and competitive landscape
 Who You Are:
 Passionate about educating customers on observability risks that are meaningful to their business, and able to build and execute an evaluation plan with a customer
 Someone with strong written and oral communication skills. This role requires an ability to understand and articulate both the business benefits (value proposition) and technical advantages of our offering
 Experienced in programming/scripting with any of the following: Java, Python, Ruby, Go, Node.JS, PHP, and .NET etc.
